style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the falcon works his whole body every beat; the pelican and the magpie move every beat they are in; the falcon's beak opens on every syllable; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; the falcon fills half the frame except the three close-up beats
character: the falcon: peregrine, black moustache stripes, yellow feet, straw sun hat, striped swim ring, leash on one foot; ONE pelican boss: grey suit, tie, falconry glove on his left wing, leather hood hanging from it, throat pouch; ONE magpie debt collector: leather jacket, gold chain, enters at 7.6
props: ONE coin lure: plain coins on a cord
environment: office rooftop: air conditioner, antenna, railing posts; sea below

audio.delivery: brisk dry male voice, weary, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: DU-mal, po-le-CHU v OT-pusk. o-ka-ZA-los', ya lish do-le-TA-yu ot zar-PLA-ty do zar-PLA-ty
audio.pacing: 0.5-6.15 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.15 not a word, sfx go on

timeline.a: the falcon swoops left to right through frame on the leash; it snaps taut with a twang, swinging him into a bank, hat flapping, ring spinning; the pelican leans back, heels sliding
the falcon arcs round the pelican close to camera, sea behind, wings banked; the pelican pivots on his heel, pays out the leash, pulls out the lure; his shoulder and the leash in the foreground
the falcon swings back in a reverse arc after the lure, wingtip skimming the roof, behind the antenna in the foreground; the pelican twirls the lure overhead
close-up: the falcon dives feet-first at the lure into the lens, talons and open beak filling the frame; the coins swing at the lens
the pelican jerks the lure away; the falcon misses, tumbles sideways through frame, rolls back into an arc
the falcon circles the pelican full round; the leash wraps the pelican, spinning him like a top; railing posts in the foreground
close-up: the pelican lunges into the lens, pouch wobbling and filling the frame, coughs ONE coin straight up; the falcon swoops in and snatches it with one foot, hat flying off

the camera hurls itself along the leash to the glove, background rushing; the falcon slams sideways onto the glove, skids on one foot, coin in the other, wings windmilling; the pelican drops the lure, slips the hood on him
the hooded falcon lunges blindly sideways, nearly falls; the magpie flies through frame, chain swinging at the lens, claws the coin from his foot and is gone; the pelican props up the glove
the falcon bolts blindly sideways off the glove; the leash yanks him back into an arc; his swim ring deflates with a whistle; the pelican braces
close-up: the pelican reels the leash in, it swings the hooded falcon into the lens; his empty talons snap shut on a round gold sun glint like a coin; hood and beak fill the frame

negative_prompt: microphone, a fourth character, slow motion, any word after 6.15, accented Russian, letters, subtitles, watermark, English speech, duplicate props, floating objects, falcon hovering in place, falcon frozen, falcon flying at the camera on his own, coin in a beak, zoom, scene change
